de.abas.ceks.jedp.session

Class BlockingActionMessage

  • Object
    • BlockingActionMessage
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable

    public class BlockingActionMessage
extends Object
implements Serializable
    Container class for blocking action messages. A blocking action message is a notfication from EDP server which tells the client to process a blocking action and to tell the server, when it has been finished, as well as when it has not been processed properly or not at all. BlockingActionMessages are provided by calls to implementations of BlockingActionMessageListener.
    Author:
    xg
    See Also:
    BlockingActionMessageListener, BlockingActionMessageSource, Serialized Form

      • getAction

        public String getAction()
        Provides the action name as string, e.g. "CMDWAIT" or "PCEXECWAIT". Action "FINISHED" indicates that server has finished waiting for a client message.
        Returns:
        the action name as string

      • getActionText

        public String getActionText()
        Provides the text for a blocking action, e.g. a command to be executed. If action is "FINISHED", this text indicates the reason for the finish message. Possible reasons are: COMPLETED, TIMEOUT, ABORTED.
        Returns:
        blocking action text.
